title: Senior Paid Media Expert
full_description:
At ING, we empower people to stay a step ahead. We are redefining banking with technology, customer focus and data-driven teams.
Our Communications, Brand & MarCom department drives growth, reputation and engagement. To support this, we are expanding our Media team.
As Senior Paid Media Expert, you will manage paid media campaigns in the Belgian market, maximize impact and drive client acquisition, working closely with our media and creative agencies. You bring strong expertise in marketing, paid media and data-driven performance analysis.
THE CENTER OF EXPERTISE COMMUNICATION, BRAND & MARCOM
You will report to the Expert Lead, collaborate closely with colleagues in Growth Area, MarCom and Branding teams, and feel comfortable managing a wide range of internal stakeholders. You will be part of the Center of Expertise (CoE) Communication, Brand & MarCom, a team of more than 50 colleagues.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead and define the awareness and consideration campaign media strategy for one or several products, with the goal of optimizing KPIs.

Monitor performance campaigns with Performance Media experts, conduct deep-dive analyses, and propose optimizations to meet target KPIs.
